data.title: Utopia
data.about:
Indulge in the pinnacle of luxury living at Damac Utopia Urban Resort Villas, where opulence meets nature in perfect harmony. Our resort-inspired villa design is a lavish retreat that seamlessly blends the sophistication of high-end resorts with the tranquility of a green community. 

Elevate your living experience to new heights at Utopia by Damac, where 27 contemporary resort-style villas redefines luxury living.  Damac Utopia boasts 3 distinct villa typologies, offering a range of 5 to 7 spacious ensuite bedrooms. Each villa boasts spacious pavilions, lush gardens, and serene water features, creating a haven that offers a resort-like escape right at home.

Nestled within an eco-conscious green community, Damac Utopia at Damac Hills offers a lavish lifestyle that effortlessly combines opulence and nature for a truly unique living experience. Discover the epitome of luxury living at Utopia by Damac Properties, where opulence meets nature in the perfect blend. Explore the Damac utopia location in the prestigious Damac Hills community, and experience a lifestyle beyond compare.

characteristics_module.title: Your Holiday Escape Everyday
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Meticulously designed residences with premium finishes and materials.
  • Smart home features for lights, AC, curtains, and more.
  • Elevators, car turntable (where applicable), sauna, steam room, and poolside hardscape.
  • Located in the prestigious Damac Hills community.
  • Access to the Trump International Golf Club, parks, fitness centers, dining options, and entertainment.
  • Active Lifestyle with Jogging tracks, cycling paths, and golfing facilities.
  • Retail outlets, gourmet restaurants, and Carrefour supermarket within the community.
  • Tranquil Waterfront Living & Calming water views evoke serenity and freshness.
  • Opulent Resort-inspired Design with Luxury villas in a green community.
  • Spacious & Serene Villas feature pavilions, lush gardens, and water features.
  • Eco-conscious Lifestyle & Green living with an eco-conscious touch.
  • Unique Oasis Experience Inspired by lush oases, symbolizing hope and abundance.

location_tile.title: Urban Resort Villas in Damac Hills
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Nestled within a tranquil and exclusive area of DAMAC Hills, Utopia Villas offer a serene escape while maintaining a strong connection to the extensive amenities of the 42 million sqft community. The location provides easy access to an array of features including the renowned DAMAC Mall, the prestigious Trump International Golf Club, Dubai, equestrian facilities, a skate park, the Malibu Bay wave pool, an assortment of luxury dining and entertainment venues, along with diverse sports facilities.

Areas Nearby:

  • Jebel Ali School – 05 minutes
  • Aster Medical Centre – 09 minutes
  • Dubai Polo & Equestrian Club – 10 minutes
  • First Avenue Mall – 11 minutes
  • Al Maktoum International Airport – 28 minutes
